_comment: Hand-authored. Drawing a whole room and one row band of it, bank 7 $EFF3-$F099. The generator for 20-traced.json subtracts these.

regions.name: Draw a whole room: set up
regions.description: In: A = the high byte of the nametable to draw into ($20 = nametable 0, $24 = nametable 1). Callers: the room load ($EF08), $EEA2 and the room-change scrolls ($F0B1, $F1C8, $F1DC). Band index $AE = 0, room-buffer offset $16 = 0, $17 = A, the scroll step $B7 = 0 and the pixel counter $AF = $20 (advanced 16 a band; nothing here reads it).

regions.name: Draw a whole room: thirteen bands
regions.description: Thirteen times: wait for queue room ($E5EB), draw one band ($F03D), and, when drawing into nametable 0 only ($17 = $20), call bank 5 $802A (-> $89FB: spawn the ground objects the band's metatiles name, through their fifth byte's high nibble). So a room's objects appear once, from the nametable-0 draw; the nametable-1 draw that precedes a scroll spawns nothing. Bands 0-11 are the room's twelve 16-pixel rows (192 bytes of the room buffer $0740, 16 a band); band 12 is the blank row 24. RUN: 13 calls with ($AE, $16) = (0, 0), (1, 16) ... (12, 192). The room buffer must be fresh: it shares its page with the object fields, so after play it is garbage (a redraw of the stale buffer put the wrong tiles in all 192 cells; after bank 5 $8003 rebuilt it, 191 of 192 cells matched the savestate, the odd one being under an object).

regions.name: Draw a whole room: nametable 0 clears the rest
regions.description: Only for nametable 0 ($17 = $20) the three blank fills below run; others jump to the wait at $F03A.

regions.name: Blank row 25 of nametable 0
regions.description: JSR $D5CC (the fill routine); its four inline bytes follow.

regions.name: Fill arguments: 64 blanks at PPU $2380
regions.description: [count $40][$23][$80][value $20]: rows 28 and 29. With band 12 (row 24) the whole of nametable 0 below the room is blank. RUN: after a draw rows 25-29 were all $20.

regions.name: Draw a whole room: wait for the queue to drain
regions.description: JMP $D7C3 (wait for the decompressor and queue); its RTS returns to the caller.

regions.name: Draw one row band: its address
regions.description: Slot-less helper (callers: $F004, the north/south scroll bands $F189 and $F207). $EACC turns the band index $AE into the attribute offset $AA and the PPU address $AC/$AD (the pair table at $EAE2); $AD is ORed with $17, which selects the nametable ($20, $24, or $28 for the corridor-style alias the north scroll uses).

regions.name: Draw one row band: ordinary band or the blank row?
regions.description: $16 is the room-buffer offset of the band: $C0 (192, one past the twelve bands) means the blank row, anything else is an ordinary band.

regions.name: Draw one row band: the blank row 24
regions.description: The row under the room, where the HUD split happens. $10 = 0 for an even band index, $0F for an odd one; the 32 tiles at $0130 are set to $20 (blank) and then tile 0 to $FE, the SOLID SPLIT MARKER (column 0 is what the sprite-0 hit sees); the eight attribute bytes $04E8-$04EF are ANDed with $10 (cleared for an even index, the low nibble kept for an odd one) and the 16 metatile ids $04C0-$04CF zeroed; $A5 = 3 (attributes and one row). RUN: row 24 read FE 20 20 20 ... after a draw.

regions.name: Draw one row band: copy the band's 16 ids
regions.description: 16 bytes from the room buffer $0740 + $16 into $04C0-$04CF (the ids the metatile drawer reads), Y advancing.

regions.name: Draw one row band: draw it and hand it to the NMI
regions.description: $16 = Y (the next band's offset); bank 5 $8009 (-> $83B3) draws the 16 metatiles into the tile rows $0130/$0150 and the attributes $04E8, writing each metatile's fifth byte back; $A5 = 1 (a row is waiting: the NMI sends the attributes and the first tile row, and the second goes into the queue through $E619). Returns. RUN: for the savestate's room the nametable and ALL 64 attribute bytes came out equal to the live ones.
